harness.purpose: Manage iterative product planning and design, frontend/backend implementation, verification, authorized deployment/recovery, and feedback through bounded parent-owned increments.

agents.description: Classify requests, construct bounded routing to specialist or implementation execution, and collect reproducible evidence.
Plan screens, interaction, and workflow before implementation; no production code changes.
Review independent evidence, issue task verdicts, and count stable defects.
Execute parent-approved code, test, and behavior-affecting configuration changes for implementation domains; ALL code, tests, and behavior-affecting configuration regardless of path.
Plan bounded product increments and cross-layer requirements for parent approval.
Prepare authorized release and recovery evidence without editing source, tests, or configuration.

handoffs.when: Screen planning request including pages, flows, forms, tables, layouts, navigation, states, interactions, and accessibility.
A product planning request has a complete parent assignment and no screen decisions are being made.
A bounded increment plan is ready for independent increment-plan-review.
Accepted implementation evidence and a complete parent release assignment require release preparation or authorized execution.
An accepted product plan requires screen structure or interaction decisions; parent dispatches after increment-plan-review.
A screen plan is available and implementation awaits independent review.
A UI plan has passed independent ui-plan-review and the parent has completed the implementation contract.
A non-UI code, test, or behavior-affecting configuration request is complete against a parent-owned contract; UI implementation uses the reviewer-to-implementer prerequisite instead.

evaluators.command: Read harness/policies/VERIFICATION.json and review the contract/result or compact TASK-RECORD evidence with harness/evaluation/TASK-REVIEW-RUBRIC.md; apply the selected risk tier and actual check evidence.
evaluators.pass_condition: Every applicable required criterion must pass; failed or pending required criteria cannot pass. Only explicitly out-of-scope criteria may be marked N/A with a recorded reason. Low and standard work may pass through applicable checks and parent acceptance; standard Sol/medium review is optional with one N/A reason when unused. High-risk work requires relevant integration checks and an independent Astra/high review. Planning-only UI tasks still require ui-plan-review; UI, release, access, and external prerequisites remain mandatory.

evaluators.command: Review the increment plan using harness/evaluation/INCREMENT-PLAN-RUBRIC.md and record harness/templates/INCREMENT-REVIEW.md evidence.
evaluators.pass_condition: Every applicable planning criterion must pass with matching plan revision and independent evidence; failed, stale, missing, or pending required evidence cannot pass. Screen decisions require a later ui-plan-review.

evaluators.command: Review release preparation or outcome using harness/evaluation/RELEASE-REVIEW-RUBRIC.md and record harness/templates/RELEASE-REVIEW.md evidence.
evaluators.pass_condition: Every applicable release criterion must pass with matching increment, contract, commit, CI, authorization, environment, recovery, and observation evidence; missing, stale, failed, or pending required evidence fails. Preparation readiness is not deployment completion.

evaluators.command: Review the screen plan using harness/evaluation/UI-PLAN-RUBRIC.md and record harness/templates/UI-REVIEW.md evidence.
evaluators.pass_condition: Every applicable rubric criterion passes with evidence and the specialist handoff is recorded; unresolved required criteria produce fail.
The verifier exits zero with canonical, provider, routing, and vendor integrity checks passing.

approval_gates.trigger: A proposed action would delete user-owned data, discard uncommitted work, or rewrite shared history beyond current authorization.
approval_gates.required_action: Obtain explicit authorization for the exact destructive action.

approval_gates.trigger: An external write, publication, message, or deployment has not already been authorized by the user.
approval_gates.required_action: Prepare the concrete result and obtain user authorization; reuse authorization already provided for this task.
